name: The Ritz-Carlton, Laguna Niguel
positioning: Coastal resort on a seaside bluff above Salt Creek Beach in Dana Point, California, with Mediterranean-inspired architecture and ocean-view suites
best_for: Travelers who want an ocean-view resort with beach service at Salt Creek Beach
Families wanting suites and a children's program for ages 5 through 12

facts.text: The resort sits atop a seaside bluff above Salt Creek Beach, with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean.
The hotel is located halfway between Los Angeles and San Diego along the coast.
The hotel is a Mediterranean-inspired four-story building with fountains and French doors that open onto private terraces.
Ocean-facing suites have long stretches of floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto patios.
The Strands Fireside Suite is on the first floor and has four patios with ocean views, outdoor firepits and a gated pathway with direct access to the beach below.
The resort offers an intimate 16-course omakase experience, and reservations are highly encouraged.
The resort offers coastal Latin cuisine by Chef Richard Sandoval with ocean views.
Raya serves pan-Latin coastal cuisine focused on sustainable seafood, local produce and organic meat.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
The spa offers signature sea-inspired therapies and ESPA and SkinCeuticals facials.
A Beach Shuttle takes guests to Salt Creek Beach, where Beach Butler service sets up chairs and umbrellas and provides towels and sunscreen.

considerations.text: Club access requires booking a Club Level room or suite, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
The spa recommends reserving treatments at least one week in advance.
The swimming pools, fitness center and fitness programming are reserved for registered overnight resort guests.
